events.verdict: Queta (BOS) brings his hand to Edwards' (MIN) side and marginal contact occurs during Edwards' driving shot attempt.

DiVincenzo (MIN) reaches in for the ball and initiates contact with Tatum (BOS), which affects his SQBR during his dribble into the frontcourt. The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
White's (BOS) arms come out slightly as he firms up in McDaniels' (MIN) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Randle (MIN) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) brings his hand towards the ball and incidental hand on ball contact occurs with White (BOS), which legally dislodges the ball from White's grasp.
McDaniels (MIN) closes out to the space in front of Tatum (BOS) and the contact after the release of the jump shot attempt is marginal.
Pritchard (BOS) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) brings his hand towards the ball and avoids making any illegal contact with Reid (MIN) during his layup attempt.
Holiday (BOS) legally contests Reid's (MIN) layup attempt in the paint.
Edwards (MIN) legally contests Horford's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) brings his hand towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Horford's (BOS) left arm as he releases his pass.
Randle (MIN) avoids making any illegal contact with Tatum (BOS) during his contest of Tatum's jump shot attempt.

Holiday (BOS) is drawn into the air on DiVincenzo's (MIN) pump fake and DiVincenzo then takes a step forward towards the basket and begins his upward shooting motion. Holiday comes down into DiVincenzo's space and contact occurs, which affects DiVincenzo's jump shot attempt.
Holiday (BOS) firms up in Edwards' (MIN) path and he absorbs the marginal contact as the two players come together during the screen.
Tatum (BOS) turns his back to the basket and begins to dribble towards the paint from the high-post and marginal contact occurs as he comes together with Alexander-Walker (MIN).
Alexander-Walker (MIN) avoids making any illegal contact with Tatum (BOS) during his legal contest of Tatum's jump shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) does not release the throw-in within five seconds.
Holiday (BOS) and DiVincenzo (MIN) come together and engage during the inbound play and marginal contact occurs as they disengage.
Edwards (MIN) steps his left foot back inbounds, which legally establishes him in the court of play prior to coming into contact with the ball.

Horford (BOS) holds his arm out as he defends the inbounds pass and marginal brush contact occurs with the side of Edwards' (MIN) head as he secures the pass. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Tatum (BOS) avoids making any illegal contact with Edwards (MIN) during his contest of Edwards' jump shot attempt.
